verdict.rationale: An OpenAPI spec is exposed publicly (composio-probe-2) which typically powers interactive API reference tools, and docs contain code snippets (e.g. composio-docs-1, composio-docs-23) showing usage examples, but there is no direct evidence of a live 'try-it-out' interactive reference UI with runnable examples. Missing for 10: explicit interactive API explorer/playground evidence, confirmation that examples are executable in-browser, independent user corroboration of using such a reference.
